positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked in developing Java controllers in Spring MVC and Hibernate framework.
• Optimized existing JavaScript code, jQuery references. Integrated AJAX calls and REST endpoints to legacy code.
• Developed UI components for several screens in Angular with TypeScript. Implemented reusable angular components like ratings widget. pipe (to filter mailbox messages by username, sort by date selection) among other work.
• Worked on Dojo modules and updated widget visuals and functionality as front-end framework for browser app.
• Worked in a fast-paced Agile team with daily scrum for actively building out customer facing mobile application.
• Worked with MySQL queries and familiar with database setup in Docker and Jenkins for CI/CD. Used JIRA, Bitbucket.

positions.title: Delivery Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed multiple analytical modules using Object oriented concepts and design patterns such as Singleton in Java.
• Wrote complex SQL queries as well as map-reduce in mongo DB to modify and model client data for daily/weekly reports.
• Used Shell and batch scripts to automate several local processes. Comfortable with Linux OS and UNIX commands.
• Worked on test case identification, preparation, requirement review, project management role including weekly tracking, documentation, and point of contact between developers and clients for quick resolution of defects.
• Took an initiative in developing automation scripts for parsing different test data received from various data streams and used this for comparison against expected results which helped in more accurate outputs and better team efficiency.
• Developed Testing suite with Selenium in JAVA. Worked on several UI styling tickets. (HTML, JSP, CSS)
